title: Maximum Length of Pair Chain
statement: Given integer pairs, select the longest chain where each pair's first value is greater than the previous pair's second value.
explanation: Sort by second value and greedily choose the earliest-ending compatible pair.

title: Palindromic Substrings
statement: Count all non-empty substrings that are palindromes.
explanation: Every palindrome has a center at a character or between two characters; expand while the ends match.

title: Replace Words
statement: Replace each word in a sentence with the shortest dictionary root that is its prefix, if such a root exists.
explanation: Store roots in a set and test prefixes of each word from shortest to longest.
example: dictionary=["cat","bat","rat"], sentence="the cattle was rattled" -> "the cat was rat"

title: Dota2 Senate
statement: Given a string of Radiant and Dire senators, simulate bans until one party remains and return the winning party.
explanation: Queue each party's indices; the earlier senator bans the opponent and re-enters at index plus n.

title: 2 Keys Keyboard
statement: Starting with one character, find the minimum number of copy-all and paste operations needed to obtain exactly n characters.
explanation: The minimum operation count equals the sum of the prime factors of n with multiplicity.

title: Find Duplicate Subtrees
statement: Return one root node for each distinct subtree structure and value pattern that appears more than once.
explanation: Assign each structural tuple a canonical ID and record a duplicate when its occurrence count reaches two.
example: root=[1,2,3,4,null,2,4,null,null,4] -> duplicate subtree roots have values 2 and 4

title: Two Sum IV - Input is a BST
statement: Return true if two distinct nodes in a BST have values summing to k.
explanation: Traverse the tree and check whether the complement of each value has already been seen.

title: Maximum Binary Tree
statement: Construct a maximum binary tree: the maximum array value is the root, with recursively built trees from the left and right subarrays.
explanation: Find the maximum in each subarray, make it the root, and recursively construct its left and right parts.

title: Robot Return to Origin
statement: Return true if a robot following U, D, L, and R moves returns to its starting position.
explanation: Count opposing moves or update x/y displacement; both final coordinates must be zero.

title: Image Smoother
statement: For each matrix cell, replace its value with the floor of the average of itself and all valid cells among its eight neighbors.
explanation: For every cell, sum all in-bounds neighbors including itself and divide by their count using integer floor division.
